paragraphs.zh: (2)2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备，主要反应过程可以以如下反应方程式表示：
paragraphs.en: (2) Preparation of 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:

paragraphs.notes: This marker carries no prose. It labels the reaction scheme drawing that follows it (drawing 1 below).

paragraphs.zh: 向反应釜中加入200mL DMF、11.8g 2-四氢呋喃甲醇(99％，0.115mol)和5.4g氢氧化钠(96％，0.13mol)，开动搅拌，控制釜温在5℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(98.2％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为3h，加毕保温反应6h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至3，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物32.6g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为95.3％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率89.1％。
paragraphs.en: Into the reaction kettle were added 200mL DMF, 11.8g 2-tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol (99％, 0.115mol) and 5.4g sodium hydroxide (96％, 0.13mol); stirring was started and the kettle temperature was controlled at 5℃. The 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid sodium salt (98.2％, 0.1mol) prepared in step (1) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, the total feeding time being 3h; after feeding was complete the temperature was held and the reaction run for 6h. When the reaction was complete the solvent was stripped under reduced pressure, 120mL water was added to the kettle residue, and after stirring to dissolve, concentrated hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 3. Then filtration, water rinsing and drying gave 32.6g of product; HPLC assay gave the content of the target compound 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid as 95.3％, a two-step reaction yield of 89.1％ calculated on 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid methyl ester.
paragraphs.notes: Printed as 200mL DMF with a space here; the parallel paragraph [0161] prints 200mLDMF with no space. Both are transcribed as printed. 2-四氢呋喃甲醇 is tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol, the reagent abbreviated THFA above the arrow in the drawing. Note the two-step yield is referenced to the methyl ester (苯甲酸甲酯), although step (1) is stated to deliver the sodium salt.

paragraphs.zh: (1)与实施例1所述步骤相同，得到含量为98.2％的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐；
paragraphs.en: (1) The same as the steps described in Example 1, giving 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid sodium salt with a content of 98.2％;

paragraphs.en: Into the reaction kettle were added 200mL DMF, 11.8g 2-tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol (99％, 0.115mol) and 8.6g potassium hydroxide (85％, 0.13mol); stirring was started and the kettle temperature was controlled at 5℃. The 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid sodium salt (98.2％, 0.1mol) prepared in step (1) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, the total feeding time being 3h; after feeding was complete the temperature was held and the reaction run for 5h. When the reaction was complete the solvent was stripped under reduced pressure, 120mL water was added to the kettle residue, and after stirring to dissolve, concentrated hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 3. Then filtration, water rinsing and drying gave 32.6g of product; HPLC assay gave the content of the target compound 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid as 95.9％, a two-step reaction yield of 89.8％ calculated on 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid methyl ester.
paragraphs.notes: Printed as 200mLDMF with no space between the volume and the solvent; transcribed as printed. This example differs from the preceding one only in the base (8.6g KOH at 85％ instead of 5.4g NaOH at 96％) and the hold time (5h instead of 6h), yet the isolated mass 32.6g is identical to the preceding example.

substituents: C(=O)ONa (carboxylate, drawn as NaO-C(=O)-) at C1
structures.name: sodium 3-(bromomethyl)-2-chloro-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate

structures.core: benzene, plus a pendant tetrahydrofuran (oxolane) ring
substituents: CH2-O-CH2- joined to the tetrahydrofuran ring at that ring's C2, at C3
structures.name: 2-chloro-3-[(tetrahydrofuran-2-yl)methoxymethyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid

drawings.notes: Single straight solid arrow. Above the arrow the two reagents are separated by the full-width enumeration comma: THFA、NaOH. Below the arrow, HCl alone. The tetrahydrofuran C2 in the product is drawn with plain lines, no wedge and no hash, so the drawing asserts no configuration there; the prose names the product (RS), i.e. racemic, which is consistent with an undrawn stereocentre. The benzene rings are drawn Kekule, with three explicit inner double bonds. The drawing carries the paragraph marker [0155], printed to its left.

discrepancies.what: The solvent DMF is written in the prose of both examples but appears nowhere in either drawing.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Above the arrow, only THFA and the base (NaOH in drawing 1, KOH in drawing 2); below the arrow, only HCl. No solvent shown.
discrepancies.text_says: [0156] 向反应釜中加入200mL DMF... and [0161] 向反应釜中加入200mLDMF... (200mL DMF charged to the kettle).

discrepancies.what: Each drawing compresses two operations into one arrow: the etherification with THFA and base, and the separate acidification workup that liberates the free acid from the salt.
discrepancies.drawing_says: One solid arrow, base above and HCl below, going straight from the sodium benzoate to the free benzoic acid.
discrepancies.text_says: The prose makes acidification a distinct workup step, after solvent stripping and water addition: 滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至3 (concentrated hydrochloric acid added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 3).

discrepancies.what: The tetrahydrofuran stereocentre is named as racemic in the prose but drawn with no stereochemistry at all.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Plain bonds at the tetrahydrofuran C2; no wedge, no hash, no (RS) label on the drawing.
discrepancies.text_says: 2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸, i.e. the (RS) racemate.

discrepancies.what: The two-step yield is stated against the methyl ester, but step (1) of each example is stated to give the sodium salt, and the sodium salt is what is drawn.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The drawn starting material is the sodium salt, NaO-C(=O)-, not a methyl ester.
discrepancies.text_says: 以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率89.1％ / 89.8％ (yield calculated on the methyl ester), while (1) 得到...苯甲酸钠盐 (gives the sodium salt).
